simulador.descricao: Put an address on the address bus and watch the decoders pick one location out of 256, the data reach the data bus, and the control and timing signals work together.
simulador.emConstrucao: Under construction (version {versao}): the memory core is in place, and the screen comes in the next versions.
etapas: Editable MAR, MDR and memory, with step-by-step read and write.
Inside view: decoders, array and buffers, with the active row and column lit.
Timing diagram with the CPU clock and wait states.
Control signals by hand and "what if…?" experiments, such as bus contention.
simulador.lerPlano: Read the full project plan (in Portuguese)

sobre.historia: MEM-8E Web opens up the memory black box: it shows what happens between an address reaching the address bus and the data leaving (or entering) through the data bus.
sobre.familia: It is a sibling of {cpu8eWeb}, the browser version of the {cpu8e} simulator, created at IESB (Brazil) by {autor} and contributors. The memory follows the same 8-bit architecture and the same names (MAR, MDR, address bus, data bus).
